title: Bumblebee eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='28' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#bfe3ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='26' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#d4ecff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='58' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#ffc928'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M27 52 Q51 44 75 52 L75 60 Q51 54 27 60 Z' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
  <path d='M28 66 Q51 62 74 66 L72 72 Q51 68 30 72 Z' fill='#3a2a6b'/>

  <circle cx='51' cy='38' r='14' fill='#ffd84a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fa0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fa0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='35' r='3' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='3' fill='#2b2140'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='34' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 43 Q51 48 56 43' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M45 26 Q42 17 36 15' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='66' cy='15' r='2.5' fill='#3a2a6b'/>

  <path d='M74 58 Q82 54 86 60 Q88 68 80 70 Q72 70 74 58 Z' fill='#ff7ab5'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='61' r='3' fill='#fff0a8'/>
  <!-- arms holding snack -->
  <path d='M70 62 Q72 58 76 58' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 68 Q73 70 76 69' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M23 64 L14 66 L23 70 Z' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M38 78 Q36 86 32 90' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 80 Q50 88 48 92' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 78 Q66 86 70 90' stroke='#2b2140' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smile crumb -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#fff0a8'/>
</svg>
